steps.title: Set up deck and labware
steps.instruction: Place the NEST 12‑well 15 mL reservoir in slot 2. Fill channel 1 with lysis and hybridization buffer (HB1), channel 2 with magnetic beads, channel 4 with wash buffer, channel 5 with master mix, and leave channel 12 empty for liquid waste. Load the USA Scientific PlateOne 96‑deep‑well 2 mL plate onto the Opentrons magnetic module GEN2. Load Opentrons 96 filter tip racks (200 µL and 1000 µL) on the deck. Mount the Opentrons temperature module GEN2 and magnetic module GEN2 according to the deck map. Attach the P300‑Multi GEN2 and P1000‑Single GEN2 electronic pipettes.

steps.title: Load samples and perform lysis
steps.instruction: Pipette each clinical sample into a 15 mL tube, then transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL tube. Add the appropriate volume of lysis and hybridization buffer (HB1) and incubate on the Opentrons temperature module GEN2 at the protocol‑specified temperature for the required time.

steps.title: Transfer to deepwell for extraction
steps.instruction: After incubation, move the lysed sample from the 1.5 mL tube into the corresponding well of the 96‑deep‑well plate on the magnetic module GEN2. Perform a one‑wash magnetic bead‑based RNA extraction as described in the protocol.

steps.title: Configure parameters and execute protocol
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, select protocol parameters. For tip‑tracking, choose “yes” to continue from the last used tip column (e.g., start at column 6 of the 3rd tip rack if the previous run ended at column 5) or “no” to start at column 1 of the 1st tip rack. Download the protocol package, upload any custom labware, calibrate labware, tip racks, and pipettes, then press “Run” to start the automated workflow.
